name: Emoji & Icon Studio by Kairesh
releaseNotes:
v2.3.0 MediaFetch AMOLED Dark Studio & Performance Update!
• Full AMOLED true dark theme with Apple HIG typography & deep contrast
• Official category pills & floating popover menu tailored to each icon library
• Native smooth Adobe folder picker with zero OS prompts or shell popups
• Precision slider + manual number typing for stroke width and size
• Ultra-low RAM optimization: hardware CSS containment & DOM virtualization for 4GB-8GB devices
